LESSON: READING ALOUD (FLUENCY)

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.7Reading Aloud (Articulation) (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub-strand
Topic 2.9: Reading Aloud (Fluency)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud (Fluency), part of Reading 2.7Reading Aloud (Articulation) (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub-strand in Grade 8 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: What is the role of consonants in reading texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify appropriate language patterns for communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud (Fluency) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. write words in varied contexts for learning,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud (Fluency) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the role spelling plays in writing.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading Aloud (Fluency) in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify appropriate language patterns for communication,

   Reading Aloud (Fluency) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. write words in varied contexts for learning,

   Reading Aloud (Fluency) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate the role spelling plays in writing.

   Reading Aloud (Fluency) helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read names of means of transport and select the appropriate pictures in groups,

2. read short texts on description of means of transport and answer the questions in pairs,

3. read short simple texts on people travelling to different places and answer simple questions in groups,

4. read short simple texts on giving directions on places to travel and discuss with peers.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read names of means of transport and select the appropriate pictures in groups,
2. read short texts on description of means of transport and answer the questions in pairs,
3. read short simple texts on people travelling to different places and answer simple questions in groups,
4. read short simple texts on giving directions on places to travel and discuss with peers.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud (Fluency) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner contributes to group decision making when they read names of means of

transport and select the appropriate pictures in groups.

35

simple questions, in groups

Social Cohesion: The learner demonstrates social cohesion when they read short simple texts on giving directions of places to

travel to, and discuss with peers

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner relates the concept of transport to the same concept in Social Studies.
